For the Petitioner : Mr. Ashish Kumar, Advocate For the State : Mrs. Nehala Sharmin, Spl.P.P.
----
06/22.03.2023 Heard the parties.

Petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Sonahatu (Rahe) P.S. Case No.32/2022, for the offences registered under Sections 406/420/467/468/120-B of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of Miss Kaveri Kumari, learned J. M. 1st Class, Ranchi.
Petitioner runs a Pragya Kendra.
It appears that Rs.3,220/-, was paid to Dhaneshwar Mahato under MANREGA Scheme.
The same was transferred to the bank account of another Dhaneshwar Mahato.
Co-accused Birendra Mahato had withdrawn the amount.
When the actual Dhaneshwar Mahato confronted him, he returned that amount to him.
This fact has been mentioned at paragraph-3 of the case diary.
Mrs. Nehala Sharmin, learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail and has submitted that petitioner had connived with Birendra Mahato and withdrew Rs.3,220/-.
In view of fact that Birendra Mahato had withdrawn Rs.3,220/- by taking benefit of the fact that there was account of two Dhaneshwar Mahato.
Prima- facie, there is nothing to show that petitioner had conspired with Birendra Mahato in withdrawing Rs.3,220/-.

Regard being had to the facts and circumstance of the case, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on anticipatory bail.

He is directed to surrender before the court below within two weeks from the date of receipt of copy of this order, and learned court below on his surrender shall release him on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs. 25,000/- (Twenty five Thousand only) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of Miss Kaveri Kumari, learned J. M. 1 st Class, Ranchi or her successor in connection with Sonahatu (Rahe) P.S. Case No.32/2022.

Subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.
(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
